personality_one_liner: A warm, clean, and nostalgic space where memories take center stage through minimalist iOS-style framing.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical rhythm. Content should breathe. Cards must have at least md margin from screen edges.

do's: Bottom action sheets/overlays on Memory Detail screen

screens.name: Onboarding/Login
screens.purpose: Introduce the app's value prop and authenticate via Google.
screens.layout: Full-bleed hero image with a top-to-bottom dark gradient scrim. Title and subtitle in the bottom 40%. Sticky 'Sign in with Google' button anchored at the bottom with safe area padding.

screens.name: Upload Photos
screens.purpose: Collect 3+ varied photos of subjects to train the model.

states.empty: Empty album illustration with 'No photos yet' message.

screens.layout: Header with 'Step 1 of 2'. Masonry or 2-col grid for uploaded photos. Sticky 'Continue' CTA at bottom. Use a dashed-border drop zone or large card for adding new photos at the top of the grid.

screens.name: Describe Memory
screens.purpose: Take text prompt input and offer curated scene suggestions.
screens.layout: Large text area (surfaceTertiary bg). Below it, a horizontal ScrollView of suggestion chips (e.g., 'Ski Lodge', 'Cancun') wrapped in brandTertiary pills. 'Generate Memory' sticky CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Generating State
screens.purpose: Engage user while the AI processes the images.

states.loading: Fullscreen animated loader or lottie animation.

screens.layout: Centered pulsing visual or progress ring with inspiring copy ('Creating your memory...').

screens.name: Memory Gallery

states.empty: Illustration of empty album with 'Create your first memory' CTA.

screens.layout: Standard 2-column grid. Cards should fill width (minus gap). No half-width orphans.

screens.name: Memory Detail
screens.purpose: View generated image, save, share, or regenerate.
screens.layout: Full-screen image edge-to-edge. Gradient fade at top for back button. Glassmorphic bottom sheet containing title, prompt, and action row (Save, Share, Regenerate).

hero_onboarding.alt: Family looking at photo album together

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the NO BLUE / PURPLE policy. Default all primary text/icons to near-black (#191818) instead of navy.
Do not use font weights over 500. Use typography scale (size) to establish hierarchy.
Implement a mandatory gradient-to-dark scrim pattern when rendering text over the hero image on the Onboarding screen.
The primary Call to Actions (CTAs) should ALWAYS be sticky at the bottom of the screen, floating above scrollable content, wrapped in a container that accounts for safe area.
Use Phosphor icons. Ensure stroke weights are consistent across all screens.
Implement haptics (impactLight) on all primary button presses.
Ensure 'Google Sign-in' button follows standard design guidelines (logo left, text right, visually distinct from standard app CTAs).
